title: 临时改计划：道歉、解释与重新约时间
subtitle: 听懂朋友为什么改约，并用自然英语提出替代安排

audio.title: Changing plans
audio.note: 官方音频总长约 2:02；本课已实际打开并连续播放核验 0:00–1:15（75 秒）。页面含完整 transcript。先不要看文字，听两遍再展开答案。

sections.title: 1｜无字幕先听（5 分钟）
sections.body:
第一遍只听 0:00–1:15，不暂停：抓人物关系、原计划和变化。第二遍再听，记下你听到的时间词与活动词。不要逐词翻译，只写关键词。

听后流程：①回答主旨题；②打开来源页 transcript 检查；③再关掉文字听一次。
questions: Francesco 为什么请 Sachi 不要买本周五的票？
两人最后提出了什么替代安排？
sections.answers:
1. 因为他本周五有一场演出，不能去剧院。
2. 先在演出前一起吃饭，并把看戏改到下周五。

sections.title: 2｜精听辨音、弱读与跟读（4 分钟）
sections.body:
只精听这三处，每处循环 3 次：
1. “What's up?”：what's 与 up 连起来，/ts/ 很轻，整体像一个节奏块。
2. “Something's come up.”：come up 辅音接元音，听成 /kʌmʌp/；不是逐词停顿。
3. “How about next week?”：how about 连读，about 的首音弱，重音落在 next week。

模仿顺序：先只听一句 → 看文字跟读两遍 → 不看文字影子跟读两遍 → 关掉文字重听整段。重点模仿重音和节奏，不追求每个词都很重。
sections.answers: 辨音提示：What's up? 是“怎么了/什么事”；Something's come up 是“临时出了点事”；How about ...? 用来提出替代方案。

sections.title: 3｜原创阅读（4 分钟）
sections.body: Maya and Leo planned to see a comedy show on Saturday evening. On Friday afternoon, Leo sent Maya a message. His sister had to work late, so he needed to look after his young nephew. Leo apologised and explained the problem clearly. He did not simply cancel and disappear. Instead, he suggested two choices: they could see the Sunday show, or they could have lunch together next Wednesday. Maya was disappointed because she had already bought the tickets, but she appreciated his honest message. She checked the theatre website and found that they could change the tickets without paying extra. They chose Sunday afternoon. Leo promised to arrive early and buy the drinks. Changing plans can be annoying, but a short apology, a clear reason and a practical alternative can protect a friendship.
questions: Why did Leo need to change the plan?
What three things helped protect the friendship?
sections.translation: 玛雅和利奥原计划周六晚上去看喜剧演出。周五下午，利奥给玛雅发了消息。他姐姐需要加班，所以他得照看年幼的外甥。利奥道了歉，并清楚地解释了问题。他没有只是取消然后消失，而是给出了两个选择：他们可以去看周日的演出，或者下周三一起吃午饭。玛雅有些失望，因为她已经买了票，但她很感谢他坦诚的消息。她查看剧院网站，发现他们无需额外付费就能改票。最后他们选择了周日下午。利奥答应早点到并负责买饮料。改变计划可能让人烦恼，但简短的道歉、清楚的理由和可行的替代方案能维护友谊。
sections.answers:
1. His sister had to work late, so he needed to look after his nephew.
2. A short apology, a clear reason and a practical alternative.

sections.title: 4｜词汇与高频词块（4 分钟）
sections.body:
1. something's come up｜临时出了点事（高频词块）
Something's come up, so I can't meet tonight.｜临时有事，我今晚不能见面了。
2. change the plan｜改变计划（高频词块）
Can we change the plan for Saturday?｜我们能改一下周六的计划吗？
3. I'm sorry, but ...｜抱歉，但是……（高频词块）
I'm sorry, but I have to work late.｜抱歉，但我得加班。
4. How about ...?｜……怎么样？（高频词块）
How about Sunday afternoon?｜周日下午怎么样？
5. Are you free then?｜你那时有空吗？（高频词块）
Are you free then, or is Monday better?｜你那时有空吗，还是周一更好？
6. make it｜能赴约；能到场（高频词块）
I can't make it at six, but seven is fine.｜我六点赶不到，但七点可以。
7. alternative｜替代方案
Let's find an alternative that works for both of us.｜我们找一个双方都合适的替代方案吧。
8. appreciate｜感谢；欣赏
I appreciate you telling me early.｜谢谢你提前告诉我。
9. promise｜保证；承诺
I promise I won't change it again.｜我保证不会再改了。

sections.title: 5｜语法：用 How about + 名词 / -ing 提建议（3 分钟）
sections.body:
How about 后接名词、时间，或动词 -ing；不要接动词原形。它适合在拒绝或改约后马上给替代方案。

例句：
1. How about next Friday?｜下周五怎么样？
2. How about meeting after work?｜下班后见面怎么样？

练习：
1. 填空：How about ___ (go) for lunch on Sunday?
2. 改写：Let's meet at 7 instead. → How about ___?
sections.answers:
1. going
2. How about meeting at 7 instead? / How about 7 instead?

sections.title: 6｜对话、替换与快速回应（3 分钟）
sections.body:
原创双人对话：
A: Hi, are we still on for dinner tonight?
B: I'm sorry, but something's come up at work. I can't make it at seven.
A: Oh, OK. Is everything all right?
B: Yes, thanks. How about tomorrow evening?
A: I have a class tomorrow. Are you free on Sunday?
B: Sunday works for me. I really appreciate your flexibility.
A: No problem. Let's meet at six.

替换练习：
1. 把 dinner / seven / tomorrow 换成 coffee / three / Friday。
2. 把 work 换成 family，并把 Sunday 换成 next Wednesday。

快速回应（每题 5 秒内开口）：
1. 朋友说：“I can't make it tonight.” 你表示理解并问明天。
2. 你临时要加班：先道歉，再提出周六。
3. 对方第三次改约：礼貌表达失望，并要求确认。

口头任务（30–60 秒）：说明一个你必须改约的情景，包含 apology + reason + alternative + confirmation 四步。
sections.answers: 参考回应：1. No problem. How about tomorrow? 2. I'm sorry, but I have to work late. Are you free on Saturday? 3. I'm a little disappointed because we've changed it several times. Can you definitely make it next Friday?

sections.title: 7｜复习与反馈（1 分钟）
sections.body:
复习上一课的 3 个词块：
1. Excuse me, where's ...?｜请问……在哪里？
2. go past ...｜经过……
3. Is this the right way to ...?｜这是去……的正确方向吗？

各造一个短句，然后回原聊天告诉我：无字幕第一遍听懂了多少百分比、最卡的是哪一句；也可以用英文或语音完成口头任务。只有收到并实际分析你的语音后，我才会评价发音。
sections.answers: 自检：今天能否不逐词翻译，直接说出 Something's come up / How about ...? / Are you free then? 三个完整词块。
